digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, JavaScript）。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 掌握可复用工程技能与开发方法论，把零散提示词变成可靠工作流

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理提供技能记忆与安全优化的性能增强框架

repos.name: microsoft/markitdown
repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源的文件转 Markdown 工具，把 Office、PDF 等文档一键转成 AI 友好的 Markdown 格式

repos.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码助手学会偷懒，只写真正必要的代码，从源头减少冗余

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
repos.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器里的间谍卫星模拟器，用真实开源数据在逼真3D地球上做实时空间情报分析

repos.name: rustfs/rustfs
repos.description: 🚀2.3x faster than MinIO for 4KB object payloads. RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration a
repos.summary_zh: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 Rust 高性能 S3 兼容对象存储，支持无缝迁移与共存

repos.name: jiji262/douyin-downloader
repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fall
repos.summary_zh: 抖音批量下载神器，支持视频图集合集音乐去水印，SQLite去重加浏览器回退，单条与主页批量都能下

repos.name: BenyRonald77/uajy-academic-rag-chatbot
repos.description: Production-grade RAG chatbot for Universitas Atma Jaya Yogyakarta academic handbook with Streamlit, FAISS vector search, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash.
repos.summary_zh: 基于FAISS与Gemini 2.5 Flash的学术手册RAG问答机器人，让校规查询秒级精准响应

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: huggingface/transformers
repos.description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both in
repos.summary_zh: 统一加载与训练文本视觉音频多模态前沿模型的 Python 框架，AI 模型开发的事实标准

repos.name: ai-dynamo/dynamo
repos.description: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework
repos.summary_zh: 数据中心级分布式推理服务框架，用 Rust 打造，专为大规模 AI 模型部署提供高吞吐低延迟的推理调度能力

repos.name: bojieli/ai-infra-book
repos.description: 《深入理解 AI Infra：量化分析与系统设计》（李博杰 著）开源书稿：从硬件约束和模型架构出发，量化推导 LLM 推理与训练系统设计。含全书正文、PDF、配套计算工具与实验
repos.summary_zh: 从硬件约束与模型架构出发量化推导 LLM 训练推理系统设计，附全书正文、PDF 与配套计算工具的开源 AI Infra 实战书稿

repos.name: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
repos.description: Official SGLang x Datawhale course on LLM inference: understand inference, build a mini-sglang from scratch, then read the real SGLang source and land
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写 mini-sglang 再读真实源码，Datawhale 出品的 LLM 推理入门到贡献 PR 实战课

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: hewanglanhao/deepvision-studio
repos.description: Interactive deep learning lab for visualizing forward/backpropagation, training real PyTorch models, and exploring CNNs, Transformers, RNNs, and AI hi
repos.summary_zh: 交互式深度学习实验室，可视化前向与反向传播并训练真实 PyTorch 模型，直观探索 CNN、Transformer 与 RNN

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: open-webui/open-webui
repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: 兼容 Ollama 与 OpenAI API 的自托管 AI 对话界面，开箱即用且功能丰富

repos.name: clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev
repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 的现代跨平台代理客户端，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供优雅易用的定制化网络代理体验

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面工具，支持自托管替代 TeamViewer，用 Rust 打造高性能低延迟的跨平台远控体验

repos.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写实现 AI 核心组件的 Python 教程，边学边造边交付，真正吃透大模型底层原理

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: microsoft/vscode
repos.description: Visual Studio Code
repos.summary_zh: 微软出品的免费跨平台代码编辑器，凭轻量极速与海量插件生态成为全球开发者首选工具

repos.name: OpenHands/OpenHands
repos.description: 🙌 OpenHands: AI-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 像工程师一样自主写代码、跑命令、改仓库的开源开发代理平台

repos.name: AlexsJones/llmfit
repos.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
repos.summary_zh: 一条命令从数百模型与供应商中筛出能跑在你硬件上的大模型，Rust 编写

repos.name: JustVugg/colibri
repos.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repos.summary_zh: 纯C零依赖让普通硬件也能跑前沿MoE大模型，专家权重从磁盘流式加载，小引擎驱动巨模型
